verdict.rationale: Webhook subscriptions are a fair question for an agent orchestration framework with a deployable Agent Server, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows in-process stream/astream iterators and Agent Server API endpoints (runs, threads, crons). None of these is a registrable outbound HTTP callback, and streaming is an adjacent feature that earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
